title: Transaction (scoring input)
description: One row of the input file given to `python -m flowguard.pipeline.score`. Accepted as CSV or parquet. Rows need not be sorted; scoring replays them in timestamp order.

transaction_id.description: Unique per row. Carried through to every output.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601. Treated as UTC when no offset is given.

source_account.description: Sending account. Use one stable id per real account: graph features are built from these ids.

destination_account.description: Receiving account, same id space as source_account.

amount_received.description: Required by the shipped model: it derives amount_ratio from it.

currency_received.description: Required by the shipped model: it derives is_cross_currency from it.

payment_type.description: Optional. NOT a model feature (it is a simulator artifact, ADR-007). Used only to attach the coverage warning to evidence bundles.

is_self_transfer.description: Optional. Derived from source == destination when absent.
